The '''Demophon Stellar Monitor Station''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] observatory located in the [[Demophon system/Legends|Demophon system]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sabotaged the observatory late during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Supernova">{{WEGCite|story=The Beginning of the End|book=Supernova (sourcebook)}}</ref>
